t: The Titan LED Work Light with Tripod provides powerful and adjustable illumination for professional tradespeople. This 60W LED work light delivers 6400 lumens of crisp 6500K daylight temperature, ensuring clear visibility across construction sites, workshops, and large outdoor projects. Built with an impact-resistant polycarbonate body and lens, and an IP65 rating, it is suitable for demanding indoor and outdoor conditions. Its integrated tripod offers stable positioning and includes a cable management system for an organised workspace. Adjustable head allows precise direction of the wide 110° beam, making it an essential lighting solution for painters, electricians, and general builders.
b: W x D x H: 1220 x 1220 x 1198mm
